name: What preparation is needed before installing new drywall in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before installing new drywall in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before new drywall installation, the bathroom space must be thoroughly prepared. This involves removing old drywall, ensuring the underlying studs are sound and free of rot or damage. All electrical wiring and plumbing pipes must be roughed in and inspected. The area should be clean and clear of debris. Proper ventilation considerations, such as exhaust fan placement, should also be finalized before drywall hanging to ensure a successful and compliant installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes removing old drywall, inspecting studs, completing electrical/plumbing rough-ins, and clearing debris before hanging new sheets.
